declaration.preface: Gautam Solar Private Limited recognizes that its greatest asset is its people and that a safe, respectful, and empowering work environment is fundamental to sustainable business success.
declaration.declaration:
The Company is committed to protecting the physical and psychological health of all employees, promoting fair working conditions, enabling career growth, and respecting human rights throughout its operations and value chain.

This policy aligns with the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, ILO Core Conventions, UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, and the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 3 (Good Health & Well-being), SDG 5 (Gender Equality), SDG 8 (Decent Work & Economic Growth), and SDG 10 (Reduced Inequalities).
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, workers, contractors, sub-contractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders engaged by Gautam Solar Private Limited, across all sites (including headquarters and manufacturing locations) and business relationships. It also addresses the Company’s direct and indirect human rights impacts on external stakeholders such as local communities, customers, and supply chain partners.

focusAreas: Human Rights Impacts on External Stakeholders

Occupational Health & Safety (Physical &: Provide a safe and healthy work environment, preventing injuries and occupational diseases
Conduct regular risk assessments (including psychosocial risks)
Provide adequate personal protective equipment (PPE) and stress management resources
Promote mental well-being through Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and stress prevention training
Working Conditions: Ensure fair remuneration, including equal pay for equal work
Provide social benefits (insurance, leave, retirement benefits) as per legal and industry standards
Promote work-life balance through flexible work arrangements where feasible
Respect the “right to disconnect” outside working hours
Conduct annual employee satisfaction surveys and act on findings
Social Dialogue: Recognize the right of employees to form or join trade unions and engage in collective bargaining
Establish structured dialogue through employee representatives or works councils
Hold regular management-employee meetings to discuss working conditions and grievances
Career Management (Recruitment to Develo: Ensure fair, transparent, and merit-based recruitment without discrimination
Conduct regular performance evaluations linked to development plans
Provide equal access to training and upskilling programs
Enable internal career mobility and succession planning
Support professional development at all career stages
Prohibition of Child & Forced Labour: Strictly prohibit child labour (below legal working age) and forced/compulsory labour in all company-owned operations
Verify age and identity documents during recruitment
Ensure no worker is required to lodge deposits or identity papers
Allow all employees the right to freely resign
Prevention of Discrimination, Harassment: Maintain a workplace free from discrimination (race, gender, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, etc.)
Prohibit all forms of harassment (physical, psychological, verbal, sexual)
Establish a confidential complaint mechanism with zero tolerance for retaliation
Provide awareness training on respectful behaviour and bystander intervention
Human Rights Impacts on External Stakeho: Identify and address direct and indirect human rights impacts on local communities, neighbours, and supply chain workers
Engage in meaningful consultation with affected stakeholders
Implement due diligence for human rights risks in procurement and project siting
Provide remedy mechanisms where the Company causes or contributes to adverse impacts

targets.target: 20% reduction in work-related accident frequency rate (lost-time injuries per 1,000 employees)
0% occupational illness cases annually
100% of departments assessed for psychosocial risks every 2 years
100% employee participation in stress prevention training annually
Employee satisfaction index ≥ 85% positive response (annual survey)
Gender pay gap (median) ≤ 5%
100% of employees covered by core social benefits (health insurance, leave, retirement)
Management-employee meetings held at least once per quarter at 100% of sites
100% of eligible employees covered by collective bargaining mechanisms (where applicable)
Grievance resolution within 30 days for 100% of raised issues
Internal promotion rate ≥ 40% of vacancies filled internally
40 training hours per employee per year
100% annual performance review completion rate
100% of new hires complete structured onboarding within 3 months
Zero incidents of child labour or forced labour (annual target)
100% age verification compliance for all new hires
100% of employment contracts include free resignation clause and prohibition of deposit retention
100% of employees complete respectful workplace training
Confidential complaint mechanism available to 100% of employees with response within 10 days
Zero substantiated cases of discrimination/harassment (or 100% corrective action within 30 days if any case occurs)
100% of operational sites have a functioning community grievance mechanism
100% screening of new high-risk projects/suppliers for human rights impacts
100% of identified human rights remediation actions completed within agreed timelines

responsibilities.duty: Overall ownership of this policy, including working conditions, career management, and discrimination prevention
Conduct employee satisfaction surveys and oversee grievance mechanisms
Ensure fair recruitment, evaluation, and training processes
Implement occupational health & safety programs (physical and psychological)
Conduct risk assessments, incident reporting, and safety training
Provide resources and strategic direction for all commitments
Approve targets and review progress annually
Ensure integration of human rights due diligence into business decisions
Implement policy requirements within their teams
Report incidents or non-compliance to HR/EHS
Promote work-life balance and respectful behaviour
Comply with safety rules, use PPE, and report hazards
Treat colleagues with dignity and respect
Refrain from discrimination, harassment, or abuse
Adhere to this policy and relevant contractual clauses
Prohibit child/forced labour in their own operations
Provide safe and respectful working conditions for their personnel

policy.monitoring:
The Company shall track progress against the above targets through:

Quarterly internal reviews by HR and EHS

Annual employee satisfaction and safety climate surveys

Periodic audits (internal and external) on human rights, safety, and labour standards

Grievance log analysis to identify recurring issues
policy.reviewMechanism:
This policy and its targets shall be reviewed annually by the HR Head and Top Management. The next review date is 01/02/2027.

Corrective action plans shall be developed for any missed targets or identified non-compliances.
